🐶 “Elon Never Contacted Us” Says Dogecoin Lead Developer

Bruce Fenton, the lead developer at Dogecoin today revealed that Elon Musk never contacted Dogecoin team. A few days ago Musk tweeted that he is working with dogecoin developers to improve the system.
